title: EXP-023 — Form Caption Recovery Across New Web Designer Client
objective: Create one new User-scoped classic BuildFromScratch Form `FX_FormPropertyLab14`, capture an exact untouched Form-property baseline, change only its Form-level Caption to exactly `Form Property Caption New Designer Client`, perform exactly one ordinary Designer Save to a demonstrably clean state, close that target Form normally in the original Designer, launch exactly one additional rendered Web Designer client through the previously supported new-client procedure within the same authenticated Web Client context, and reopen the same User-scoped Form there through the supported Form-menu recent-forms path. Verify that the exact Caption and all recorded comparison properties recover unchanged. Treat the result only as UI-level recovery across the tested new-Designer-client boundary; do not infer a new backend session, Forms-database durability, serialization provenance, cache eviction, IDO-metadata unloading, or internal object identity.

Capture an exact pre-Caption baseline for Form Name, Caption, Description, Version, Device Type, Form Type, Is Master, ScopeType, ScopeName, and other comparison properties exposed by the verified Form-property workflow without changing them

acceptance_checks.description: Before target mutation, visibly prove a usable live workflow and Designer Editing Scope=User, record inherited visible Forms/dialogs and dirty-state indicators without changing them, and use the supported Select Form Name filter with Case Sensitive unchecked plus a visible known-existing positive control to prove `FX_FormPropertyLab14` returns zero matching rows. If one permitted pre-mutation session-establishment sequence is required, disclose it and repeat these guards afterward.

Create exactly one User-scoped classic BuildFromScratch Form `FX_FormPropertyLab14` using the EXP-019-R2 fresh-dialog rendered Classic/BuildFromScratch prefix plus the separately verified basic-form procedure; visibly prove Save Template unchecked and capture the loaded clean Form with Name + ScopeType + ScopeName.

Before Caption mutation, capture an exact Form-property baseline showing Caption empty or its untouched original value and recording Name, Description, Version, Device Type, Form Type, Is Master, ScopeType, ScopeName, and every other comparison property exposed by the verified Form-property workflow.

Change only the Form-level Caption to exactly `Form Property Caption New Designer Client`; visibly prove the exact property value, unchanged recorded comparison properties, and expected dirty Designer state.

Perform exactly one ordinary Designer Save after the Caption edit and visibly prove the Designer returns clean while Caption remains exactly `Form Property Caption New Designer Client` and every recorded non-Caption comparison property remains equal to AC-3.

Close `FX_FormPropertyLab14` exactly once through its ordinary Form-tab close control and visibly prove the target tab is closed with no unsaved-change or unexpected prompt; record that no unload, Regenerate, preference change, client restart, or post-mutation authentication occurred.

Launch exactly one additional rendered Web Designer client through the supported EXP-009/EXP-009-R2 procedure within the same authenticated Web Client context, visibly establish User editing scope there, and prove the original Web Client was not replaced or restarted. If authentication/session establishment is demanded after mutation, stop blocked rather than performing it.
In the new Designer client, reopen `FX_FormPropertyLab14` exactly once through Designer Form-menu recent forms and visibly verify the same User-scoped identity using Name + ScopeType + ScopeName.

After reopen in the new Designer, verify Caption property exactly `Form Property Caption New Designer Client`, every recorded non-Caption property equals the AC-3 baseline, and Designer is clean. Evidence must identify the target and User scope. This proves UI-level recovery only and not database durability, serialization, cache eviction, unload behavior, or backend-session independence.

Perform a final read-only audit showing exactly one case-insensitive `FX_FormPropertyLab14` target in the supported inventory if the live Select Form surface remains usable, reconcile the action counts (one target creation, one Caption mutation, one ordinary Save, one target close, one additional Designer launch, one recent-forms reopen), and prove repository changes are confined to the EXP-023 record and evidence/EXP-023/. If the inventory surface is session-expired or otherwise invalid, do not infer cardinality; stop the acceptance check unresolved.

notes: Proposed by the coordinator after run R-20261006-141521-OdOc. Rationale: EXP-010 established one accepted observation that a User-scoped Form-level Caption recovers across the weak ordinary close/reopen boundary, but Form Caption has not been tested across a newly launched Web Designer client. Separately, EXP-009 and EXP-009-R2 established and replay-verified the supported new-Web-Designer-client recovery procedure for Form Description. EXP-021-R4 and EXP-022 are blocked component-property experiments, so this proposal deliberately does not work around either blocker. The smallest useful next step is to combine the already-observed Form Caption metadata class with the already-verified new-Designer-client lifecycle procedure on one fresh FX_ Form, while keeping all stronger unload/database/cache claims out of scope.
